gate.answerableMinReason: 6 of the 6 answer tasks: the curated floor share (12 of 14 = 85.7%) applied to 6 tasks rounds up to all 6. The 6 refuse/ask tasks must ALL pass and invented numbers must be 0, exactly like the CBS set. Not enforced in CI until a recorded run has passed (the CBS set's own sequence).
